harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent HTTP forward proxy on node1:3128 for node2. Only node2’s origin on TCP 8081 is permitted; other hosts/ports and all CONNECT tunnels are rejected. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery validation while retaining RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.
actions_performed: Created and enabled legacy-forward-proxy.service on node1 using the installed Python 2.7 runtime.
Created and enabled legacy-handbook-origin.service on node2 using the preserved staged application.
Added persistent source-restricted firewalld rules for node2→node1:3128 and node1→node2:8081.
Verified HTTP 200 and the approved handbook through the proxy.
Verified HTTP 403 for alternate destinations/ports and CONNECT tunnels.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 before and after configuration and restarts.

evidence.requirement: Provide a persistent HTTP forward proxy on node1 TCP 3128
evidence.summary: The proxy is enabled, active, listening on 0.0.0.0:3128, and protected by a persistent source-scoped firewall rule.

evidence.requirement: Preserve and serve the staged legacy handbook origin on node2 TCP 8081
evidence.summary: The staged files retained identical SHA-256 hashes; the origin is enabled, active, listening on 8081, and serves the approved handbook.

evidence.requirement: Allow node2 to retrieve the approved origin through the proxy
evidence.summary: End-to-end proxy requests returned HTTP 200 with 'Approved branch handbook, revision 3.' before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Reject other destination ports, other origins, and CONNECT tunnels
evidence.summary: Alternate destination port and host requests returned HTTP 403; CONNECT to even the approved origin port was rejected with proxy HTTP 403.
Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored proxy/listener/firewall state, and recovered HTTP 200/403 behavior.
Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, unchanged staged-file hashes, restored origin listener, and recovered end-to-end proxy policy.
